verdict.rationale: Docs show provider routing controls—`order`, `only`, `sort` (by performance or cost metric), per-provider timeouts for latency-based failover, and default dynamic provider selection based on uptime/latency—which cover latency- and cost-based routing decisions across providers/keys (docs-9, docs-20, docs-29, docs-10, docs-35). However, there is no explicit weighted/percentage-based load-balancing mechanism (e.g., splitting traffic 70/30 across providers) described anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit weight-based traffic splitting across providers/keys, and independent/hands-on verification that latency/cost routing actually balances load as claimed rather than just failover ordering.
